note: Ps61 rock-higher-than-I (corrected; longing psalm). Human IB: the cry (rinnah)/prayer (tefillah)/call from the end of the earth; the fainting (ataph) heart; the humble longing to be led to the rock HIGHER than himself (reach beyond self); to DWELL in God's tent + TAKE REFUGE under his wings; joining those who FEAR God's name; the perpetual SING-PRAISES + daily PERFORM vows. God-qualifiers=13 (hear/listen/lead/refuge/strong-tower/heard + the king-intercession prolong/appoint chesed+faithfulness/watch-over + name x2). Rock/tower/shelter/wings images + forever + vows-objects + heritage = standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: cry / ringing cry (rinnah - hear my cry)
'HEAR my CRY (rinnah), O God' — the ringing cry of a soul reaching to God; rinnah here the earnest call the psalmist begs God to hear (the qualifier), the voice of his need from the ends of the earth
paired with the cry, voiced in the calling (v2)
that God would listen to it (v1)
'listen to my PRAYER (tefillah)' — the appeal the psalmist lifts to God; tefillah here the settled prayer twinned with the cry, which he asks God to attend to — his whole recourse in distress
call (qara - from the end of the earth I call to you)
from the end of the earth, heart fainting
the cry and prayer now as a calling from afar

'from the end of the earth I CALL (qara) to you when my heart is faint' — the reach of prayer across every distance; qara here the calling from the farthest exile of body or soul — no remoteness too great to cry to God when the heart fails
heart (leb - when my heart is faint)
the faint heart that drives the calling

'when my HEART (leb) is faint' — the inner core failing under distress; leb here the seat of courage and life, grown feeble — the weakness that sends the psalmist reaching for a rock higher than himself
be faint / overwhelmed (ataph - my heart is faint)
the fainting that marks the heart

'when my heart is FAINT (ataph)' — the swooning weakness of the overwhelmed soul; ataph (to be feeble/enveloped) the sinking of the inner self, the honest admission of exhaustion that turns to God's higher strength
be high / higher (rum - the rock that is higher than I)
the psalmist (longing to be led there)
long to be led up to it
issues in dwelling and taking refuge in God (v4)

'Lead me to the rock that is HIGHER (rum) than I' — the reach beyond self to a security above one's own strength; rum here the height the fainting heart cannot climb alone — the confession that safety lies in a rock higher than himself, to which God must lead (the qualifier)
dwell / sojourn (gur - let me dwell in your tent)
paired with taking refuge under his wings

'Let me DWELL (gur) in your tent forever!' — the longing for permanent nearness to God; gur here the desire to be God's abiding guest — not a fugitive's brief shelter but a settled home in his presence, forever
take refuge (chasah - take refuge under the shelter of your wings)
under the shelter of God's wings
paired with dwelling in his tent
because God has been his refuge and strong tower (v3)

'Let me TAKE REFUGE (chasah) under the shelter of your wings!' — the sheltering under God like a bird's young (cf Ps57:1); chasah here the hiding in God's protective nearness, resting on the God who has already been his refuge and strong tower (v3, the qualifiers)
fear / revere (yare - those who fear your name)
the company whose heritage the psalmist is given

'you have given me the heritage of those who FEAR (yare) your name' — the psalmist counted among the God-fearing; yare here the reverent fear of God's name that marks his people, whose inheritance he is granted — belonging to the fearing community is itself the gift
sing praises (zamar - I will ever sing praises to your name)
paired with performing his vows day after day
in response to God's steadfast love and faithfulness (v7)

'So will I ever SING PRAISES (zamar) to your name' — the perpetual praise that answers God's faithfulness; zamar here the ceaseless song vowed in return for the steadfast love and faithfulness that guard the king (v7, the qualifiers) — worship as a lifelong response
perform / pay (shalam - as I perform my vows day after day)

'as I PERFORM (shalam) my vows day after day' — daily, faithful discharge of what was promised; shalam here the paying of vows made habitual — devotion not in a single burst but renewed each day, the steady rhythm of a grateful life
God's hearing asked of the cry (v1)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's act asked): 'HEAR (shama) my cry, O God' - God's hearing is not a human IB char; the attention the psalmist's cry (280856) seeks. Qualifier.
attend / listen (qashab - listen to my prayer)
God's attending asked of the prayer (v1)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's act asked): 'LISTEN (qashab) to my prayer' - God's attending is not a human IB char; the notice the psalmist's prayer (280860) begs. Qualifier.
lead / guide (nachah - lead me to the rock)
God asked to lead him to the rock higher than himself (v2)

v2 QUALIFIER (God's act asked): 'LEAD (nachah) me to the rock that is higher than I' - God's leading is not a human IB char; the guidance the fainting psalmist needs to reach the height beyond himself (280870). Qualifier.
refuge (machseh - you have been my refuge)
God has been his refuge, ground of his taking refuge (v3)

v3 QUALIFIER (God as refuge): 'for you have been my REFUGE (machseh)' - God as refuge is not a human IB char; the shelter that grounds the psalmist's plea to take refuge under his wings (280880). Qualifier.
strength (oz - a strong tower against the enemy)
God's strength, the strong tower that grounds his refuge (v3)

v3 QUALIFIER (God as strength): 'a STRONG (oz) tower against the enemy' - God's strength is not a human IB char; the strong tower the psalmist takes refuge in (280880), his defence against the foe. Qualifier.
hear (shama - you have heard my vows)
God has heard his vows and granted the heritage of the God-fearing (v5)

v5 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'you, O God, have HEARD (shama) my vows' - God's hearing is not a human IB char; the answered prayer by which he is given the heritage of those who fear God's name (280890). Qualifier.
name (shem - those who fear your name)
God's name, the object of the God-fearers' reverence (v5)
v5 QUALIFIER (God's name): 'the heritage of those who fear your NAME (shem)' - God's name is not a human IB char; the object of the reverent fear that marks his people (280890). Qualifier.
prolong / add to (yasaph - prolong the life of the king)
God asked to prolong the king's life, prompting the psalmist's praise (v6->v8)

v6 QUALIFIER (God's act asked): 'PROLONG (yasaph) the life of the king; may his years endure' - God's lengthening the king's reign is not a human IB char; the intercession whose answer the psalmist will meet with perpetual praise (280904). Qualifier.
appoint / ordain (manah - appoint steadfast love and faithfulness)
God asked to appoint his love and faithfulness to guard the king (v7)

v7 QUALIFIER (God's act asked): 'APPOINT (manah) steadfast love and faithfulness to watch over him' - God's appointing is not a human IB char; his ordaining of chesed and faithfulness as the king's guardians, prompting the psalmist's praise (280904). Qualifier.
God's love appointed to guard the king, ground of the praise (v7)

v7 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'appoint STEADFAST LOVE (chesed)... to watch over him' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; the guardian ordained for the king, which the psalmist answers with song (280904). Qualifier.
God's faithfulness appointed to guard the king, ground of the praise (v7)

v7 QUALIFIER (God's faithfulness): 'and FAITHFULNESS (emet) to watch over him' - God's reliability is not a human IB char; twinned with chesed as the king's guardian, moving the psalmist to perpetual praise (280904). Qualifier.
watch over / preserve (natsar - to watch over him)
God's love and faithfulness watch over the king (v7)

v7 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'to WATCH OVER (natsar) him' - God's guarding (through his love and faithfulness) is not a human IB char; the preservation of the king that grounds the psalmist's praise (280904). Qualifier.
name (shem - sing praises to your name)
God's name, the object of the psalmist's perpetual praise (v8)
v8 QUALIFIER (God's name): 'I will ever sing praises to your NAME (shem)' - God's name is not a human IB char; the object of the psalmist's ceaseless song (280904). Qualifier.
rock (tsur - the rock that is higher than I)

v2: 'lead me to the ROCK (tsur) that is higher than I' - God imaged as the high, unreachable rock of safety; the refuge-image, the longing for it the char (280870). Standalone (image of God's security).
v3: 'a strong TOWER (migdal) against the enemy' - God imaged as a fortified tower; the strength is the qualifier (280873), here the tower-image of his protection. Standalone (image).
forever / eternity (olam - dwell in your tent forever)
v4: 'Let me dwell in your tent FOREVER (olam)!' - the perpetuity of the longed-for dwelling (280877); a temporal extent, the permanence of nearness sought. Standalone (temporal).
shelter / covering (sether - the shelter of your wings)
v4: 'under the SHELTER (sether) of your wings' - the covert of God's protective wings; the refuge-taking is the char (280880), here the shelter-image. Standalone (image of God's protection).
v4: 'the shelter of your WINGS (kanaph)' - the image of God sheltering his own like a bird its young (cf Ps57,61); the refuge is the char (280880), here the wing-metaphor. Standalone (image).
vows (neder - you have heard my vows)
v5: 'you, O God, have heard my VOWS (neder)' - the vows God has heard; the object of his hearing (qualifier 280886), the performing of them the char in v8 (280907). Standalone (the vows heard).
heritage / possession (yerushah - the heritage of those who fear your name)

v5: 'you have given me the HERITAGE (yerushah) of those who fear your name' - the inheritance God grants the psalmist among the God-fearing (280890); God's gift, an outward possession. Standalone (God's gift).
forever / eternity (olam - enthroned forever before God)

v7: 'May he be enthroned FOREVER (olam) before God' - the perpetuity of the king's reign, the content of the intercession (v6-7); the wished duration of his throne, not an individual inner operation. Standalone (the king's perpetual reign).
vows (neder - as I perform my vows)
v8: 'as I perform my VOWS (neder) day after day' - the vows the psalmist daily performs; the performing is the char (280907), here the vows themselves as its object. Standalone (the vows performed).
